description: Run one query on several Amazon stores in parallel (default pl, de, fr, it, es, nl; at most 10) and merge the results in PLN — the cheapest first by default. Costs one SerpAPI credit PER STORE (6 by default). By default foreign stores are asked to deliver to Poland (shipping_location 'PL'): they list only items they ship here, with the delivery cost in `delivery`, and usually print prices already in PLN (Amazon's conversion, Polish VAT) — shipping is never included in price_pln. shipping_location 'local' compares each store as its own customers see it (NBP-converted, no delivery guarantee). Identical ASINs across stores are grouped in `asin_matches` with each store's price and the cheapest one — the reliable way to compare the exact same product. Use a precise query (brand + model) and min_price_pln to keep accessories out of a price-sorted list. Result shape: { source, fetchedAt, query, marketplaces: [{ marketplace, country, currency, status ('ok' | 'no_results' | 'error'), total_results, count, search_url, error? }], count, products: [...], asin_matches?: [{ asin, title, offers: [{ marketplace, price, currency, price_pln, url }], cheapest: { marketplace, price_pln }, spread_pln }], fx: [...], note } — the list key is `products`; each product is { marketplace, position, asin, title, brand?, url, image?, price, price_text, currency, price_pln, old_price?, discount_percent?, rating, reviews, bought_last_month?, prime?, sponsored, delivery?, stock? }. A store that fails or finds nothing is reported in `marketplaces`, not as an error.

brand.description: One brand name, e.g. 'Sony' (Amazon's brand filter on every store).

delivery_zip.description: Delivery postal code within shipping_location's country (or the store's), e.g. '00-001'.

exclude_autocorrected.description: Drop results from an auto-corrected spelling of the query. Default false.

limit.description: Max products in the merged list. Default 40.

limit_per_marketplace.description: Max products kept per store. Default 10.

marketplaces.description: Stores to compare, codes or domains (pl, de, fr, it, es, nl, be, se, uk, tr, us, ca, mx, br, au, jp, in, cn, sg, ae, sa, eg). Default pl, de, fr, it, es, nl; at most 10 — one SerpAPI credit each.

match_asin.description: Group the same ASIN found on 2+ stores into asin_matches. Default true.

max_price_pln.description: Highest price in PLN, applied like min_price_pln.

min_price_pln.description: Lowest price in PLN: sent to each store in its currency (NBP rate, 10% slack) and enforced exactly on price_pln.

min_rating.description: Keep products rated at least this (0–5).

min_reviews.description: Keep products with at least this many ratings.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh SerpAPI fetch, bypassing this server's 5-minute result cache. Default false.

order_by.description: Order of the merged list: price_pln (default, cheapest first, unpriced last), relevance (the stores' own rankings interleaved) or rating.

query.description: Search query, ideally brand + model, e.g. 'sony wh-1000xm5'.

shipping_location.description: Deliver-to country for the foreign stores. Default 'PL'; 'local' = each store's own country (prices in its currency and VAT, delivery to Poland unchecked).

sort.description: Sort sent to every store. Amazon's sort: relevance (default, Amazon's 'Featured'), price_asc, price_desc, rating (avg. customer review), newest, bestsellers. The price sorts are re-applied to the returned page by displayed price (Amazon sorts by its offer prices), with products that show no price listed last.

name: amazon_compare
title: Compare an Amazon search across stores (PLN)
